gbm_population_evidence.quote: The type and grade of glioma to follow the 2021 WHO Classification of Tumors of the Central Nervous System, allowing Grade III and IV gliomas.
To assess overall survival following 186RNL in patients with bevacizumab naïve recurrent glioblastoma following treatment with a second administration of 186RNL.

gbm_population_flag.reason: Glioblastoma itself is named only in keywords and outcomes; eligibility allows grade III and IV gliomas under WHO 2021, which includes glioblastoma but does not name it, so high_grade_glioma_unspecified is also possible.

candidate_evidence.quote: [EXPERIMENTAL] Retreatment with Rhenium Liposome: Each participant will receive a single administration of 186RNL.

treatment_setting_evidence.quote: Patients must have malignant glioma that has progressed on or after standard treatment (surgery, radiotherapy, and/or chemotherapy) and are planned to undergo stereotactic biopsy as per standard of care.

tumour_pk_planned_evidence.quote: Spectroscopic imaging will then be obtained at predefined time points to visualize the distribution of the 186RNL as well as calculated the actual dose retained within the tumor.

role_evidence.quote: 186RNL will be infused through the CED catheter at the predetermined dose.

agents.drug_class_hint: rhenium-186 (186Re) nanoliposome (186RNL), locally delivered radionuclide therapy

coder_notes: Retreatment with 186RNL by convection-enhanced delivery (CED catheter). Brief summary says intraventricular route, whereas description/interventions say CED into tumour; formulation flagged new_route. device_dependent set false on the basis that CED is treated as a route (manual formulation_flag example), not device activation; adjudicator may prefer true under R4. Tumour PK coded yes because imaging quantifies drug/dose retained within tumour (dosimetry), a judgement. Moiety named without isotope per W1.
